source_matching.basis: stored Blender object matrix; world X,Z,Y * source scale + anchor

identity: blue upper receiver and sloping carry bridge
red lower frame and substantial slanted grip
exposed black upper barrel within red cage
knurled lower cylinder and original source decals

geometry_rationale.receiver: Broad filled masses preserve transverse depth and grip anchor.
geometry_rationale.barrel: Octagonal walls keep actual bores; solid breech closes their recessed rear.
geometry_rationale.cylinder: Eight knurled walls and eight nozzle walls model the forward cylinder, with a solid rear closure.
geometry_rationale.cage: Open rails/posts frame the exposed barrel in side and oblique views.
geometry_rationale.brace: Cross lugs and bridge preserve the distinctive orange/blue muzzle silhouette.
geometry_rationale.grip: Thick core, slanted backstrap and heel preserve hand frame; grooves are UV.
geometry_rationale.guard: Swept open-bottom guard as in source; no opaque panel crosses finger clearance.

limitations: Authored matte default paint is not original PBR reconstruction.
Minor screws, grip relief, housing channels and knurl are face UV, not perforations.
Octagonal barrel/cylinder and simplified brace approximate curved source surfaces.
Static full model retains generic reload; no new split reload or moving cylinder.
Offline orthographic comparisons do not certify native views, pack load, ADS or performance.
